input.reason: The request's "seen" flag maps to WatchItem.watched (the only such flag in the model). The store owns list state and persistence, so it gains clearWatched(); the watchlist page gains a "Clear watched" button that delegates to it. Additive change — other WatchlistStore importers (movie-detail, search) are unaffected.

steps.instruction: The user request asks to clear every movie whose "seen" flag is true; in this codebase that flag is `WatchItem.watched`. Add a public method `clearWatched(): void` to WatchlistStore that removes every item with `watched === true`. Behaviour: (1) unwatched items must remain, keeping their existing relative order; (2) `items`, `count` and `watchedCount` must all reflect the removal; (3) the resulting list must be persisted to localStorage under the existing KEY exactly like the other mutators (add/remove/toggleWatched), so a freshly constructed WatchlistStore sees the cleared list; (4) if no items are watched, the call must leave state and persisted data unchanged (harmless no-op). Keep all existing members and behaviour (add/remove/toggleWatched, the storage key, signal wiring) intact and do not modify any existing test. You may add extra unit tests in your own spec file.

The user request asks for a button that clears every watched ("seen") movie from the watchlist. In src/app/watchlist/watchlist.html add a `<button type="button" class="clear-watched">` with a visible label like "Clear watched" (or an equivalent aria-label), placed sensibly near the watched-count/progress summary or the list header. Bind its (click) to a new public component method `clearWatched(): void` that delegates to `this.store.clearWatched()`. WatchlistStore is gaining that method this round (same round, parallel owner) with signature `clearWatched(): void` — it removes all items with `watched === true` and persists. Clicking the button must leave the rendered list, `watchedCount` and `progress` in sync. Follow the component's existing screen-reader convention: set `announcement` when the button is used (wording up to you, e.g. mention how many movies were cleared). You may disable the button while `watchedCount() === 0`, but it must be enabled and functional whenever at least one movie is watched. Do not change or remove any existing test.
